title: Normalize Windows paths before binding repository resource scopes
summary: Portable repository paths and physical OS paths serve different purposes; normalize at the conversion boundary rather than weakening a capability issuer.
hint_triggers: Windows path.relative returns backslashes. toRepoRelative and normalizeStoredPath must emit slash-separated references for paths within the checkout while preserving foreign and relative path semantics. Keep physical filesystem assertions OS-aware and canonical resource assertions portable. Do not accept backslashes in grant issuers to compensate for unnormalized caller paths. The diagnosed defect caused five production autonomy receipt tests to fail; all five passed after canonical conversion was repaired. Independent review verified drive and UNC containment and unchanged POSIX behavior.
